question: Do all six deposited GSE242510 count matrices satisfy complete entry integrity and what technical QC ranges inform a subsequent frozen conservative annotation strategy?
decision: Permit the next annotation contract only after full source entry integrity succeeds; keep biological preparation identities unknown.
strongest_rival: Treating slices, wells, cell barcodes, library suffixes or accession IDs as independent animals, preparations or donors would create pseudoreplication or false pairing.
discriminator: Join GEO, BioSample and sequencing accessions; inspect workbook labels and source panel legends; validate count-file structure without treating missing identifiers as evidence of independence.
exposure_record: Publication outcomes, source labels and workbook contrasts were already exposed. Only count headers and feature/barcode identifiers were inspected before this freeze; no local Arg1/Il6 cell-class contrast has run.
biological_unit: Animals for whole-lung panels; human donor pairs or patients for human assays; coculture preparation identity and pooling remain unknown for GSE242510.
nesting_and_overlap: Slices and wells nest in source patients or donor combinations; cells nest in libraries. Numeric library suffixes do not prove preparation pairing. Source panels and deposited data are reused published evidence, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: The official JCI188734 supporting-values workbook and six GSE242510 libraries, with linked public BioSample and sequencing records. Source-selected published panels; no new cohort.
contrast: Library-by-library technical integrity and QC summaries; no expression comparison or biological effect.
endpoint: Actual matrix entry count, integer/nonnegative values, index bounds, duplicate coordinates, unique feature/barcode counts, total counts, detected genes and mitochondrial count proportion per deposited barcode.
methods: Fully decompress and parse each matrix with scipy.io.mmread; compare declared/actual entries and dimensions; enforce unique coordinate/feature/barcode identities and integer nonnegative values; reconcile count totals; save per-barcode QC and all-library diagnostic plots.
missingness_and_exclusions: No cell filtering or class assignment. Explicit zero entries are counted then excluded from detected-gene totals; negative/noninteger data, duplicates, index errors, truncated data or identifier mismatches stop execution.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests or biological effect estimation.
precision_basis: Technical source checks do not estimate population precision.
interpretation_limit: Passing matrix integrity does not validate cell identity, doublet/ambient removal, biological independence, preparation pairing or population expression inference.
stop_rule: Stop after full-entry integrity and technical QC; freeze a distinct annotation/QC and descriptive expression contract only after reviewing this output.
amendment_reason: Initial full-entry technical integrity pass after approved source qualification and functional reconstruction.
